items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I love Coltrane myself, except for the final period... I think that’s great, I love that.

ctx.x: Yeah, just the ridiculousness of that over studied, under feeling sort of music. So they really embraced him because they hadn’t heard anybody play a tenor saxophone without John Coltrane in mind, for like I said well probably fifteen, twenty years or better than that.
Yeah, Coltrane really like, well he predominated the scene much as Parker did I guess.
